title: EvaluationRegisterHead
description: A published chain head of the evaluation register (ADR-010 O1): the entry hash at one position, with no secret. A file of this shape merged to main by pull request, or attested, is the trusted timestamp of every entry up to seq; the verifier refuses a register that is shorter than a published head or has another hash at that position.

seq.description: The position of the head entry.

entry_hash.description: The hash of the entry at seq.
